prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript domain-event module exporting `EntityKey`, `NoteSnapshot`, `DomainRecord`, `NoteRevisedRecord`, and `RevisionValue`.

`EntityKey` is a class constructed with a nonblank string and exposes `toString(): string`. `NoteSnapshot` has `key: EntityKey`, `body: string`, and `revision: number`. `RevisionValue` is `string | number | boolean | null`. `DomainRecord` requires readonly `occurredAt: number` and `getEntityKey(): EntityKey`.

`NoteRevisedRecord` implements `DomainRecord`. Its constructor accepts `(occurredAt: number, note: NoteSnapshot, changes: Readonly<Record<string, RevisionValue>>)`. Require `occurredAt` to be a finite nonnegative number, `note.body` to be a string, `note.revision` to be a nonnegative integer, and every change key to be nonblank; reject invalid data. At least one change is required. The event must expose readonly `note` and `changes` snapshots and return the note key from `getEntityKey`.

Copy and freeze the note snapshot and changes map without freezing or mutating caller-owned objects. Later mutation of objects originally passed to the constructor must not affect the event. Preserve the insertion order of change keys.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
